verdict.rationale: Users create a named Bot by describing its job, which serves as its instructions. Each Bot keeps its own memory, files, preferences and saved skills, and can be duplicated or shared as a template so others start from the same Bot. Team Bots can also be invited into shared channels. A month-long community user confirms that each bot owns its own context, domain and skills. Missing for 10: explicit docs on attaching a dedicated knowledge base or documents to a Bot, detail on how template sharing works, and independent corroboration of the sharing flow.
